# Elara Voss — Creative & Lifestyle

> A creative lifestyle portfolio demo with art direction, brand projects, a journal, and a contact experience.

## Pages
- [Home](https://vibed-personal.xavainf.com/)
- [/about](https://vibed-personal.xavainf.com/about)
- [/work](https://vibed-personal.xavainf.com/work)

## Scope
This is a sample portfolio. Identities, achievements, projects, and business details are illustrative. The contact form does not send or save messages. Project pages describe bundled sample work; this site has no live business API or booking service.
